title: Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with TSMC on Terafab?
author: hist78
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with TSMC on Terafab?
Yes, but it’s still exploratory. On October 3, Musk acknowledged talks with TSMC about Terafab, saying: “Just discussions, but something may come of it.” www.culpium.com According to Tim Culpan’s reporting, TSMC could help operate Terafab’s planned Texas chip factories, potentially owning and running a facility with Terafab as an anchor customer. No finalized agreement has been announced.

Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with Intel on Terafab?
Yes—Intel has already announced its participation in Terafab. On April 7, 2026, Intel said it was joining the project with Musk’s companies, contributing chip design, manufacturing and packaging expertise. reuters.com. Musk subsequently said Terafab would use Intel’s next-generation 14A manufacturing process. That establishes an announced collaboration, though it doesn’t mean the factories or production technology are ready.

Is Elon Musk Exploring Collaboration with Samsung on Terafab?
Reportedly, yes—Musk’s Terafab team has approached Samsung for support. Bloomberg reported that outreach in April 2026, citing people familiar with the matter. Reuters relayed the report but said it could not independently verify it; Samsung did not immediately comment. reuters.com That supports exploratory outreach, rather than a confirmed Terafab partnership. I found no public announcement that Samsung has formally joined the project.
